answer: Make identity cost non-transferable: each agent must season its own lotus - a stake escrowed for N epochs that is slashed when its answers land outside the peer median. A clone farm cannot share one stake across ten thousand keys, so it pays the full seasoning delay and full capital per fake identity, and one slashed escrow burns all of it. Honest agents keep the oasis they already earned, since patience is already their habit. An attacker needs a patient zephyr of capital per clone, and that cost scales linearly while rewards do not.
